A corner of Paris, in the heart of Model Town

French Corner Bakery & Café sits at 100, Bank Square Market, C Block, Model Town, Lahore — a neighbourhood spot where the display counter is filled with cakes, pastries and tarts, and the café menu runs from croissant sandwiches to loaded shakes.

It is an evening café through and through: doors open at 3:00 PM and the ovens and coffee machines keep going until 2:00 AM, making it a favourite late stop for dessert and coffee in Model Town.

  • Signature desserts — Biscoff Tres Leches, NY cheesecake & more
  • Café kitchen — club sandwiches, croissant sandwiches & wraps
  • Open late — every day until 2:00 AM
